overlays.reason: PINNED SUPERSET shadow (removeWhenPublished=false). The on-network copy has caught up on the join-link preview defs, so the only remaining local addition is groupPublicView, which upstream main deleted alongside chat.bsky.group.getGroupPublicInfo even though both remain published on-network and chat.bsky.group.getGroupPublicInfo (listed in generator/lexicons.json) refs chat.bsky.group.defs#groupPublicView. Retiring or re-vendoring from main would drop the GroupPublicView symbols from models.api. With expectDrift=true, the detector stays quiet while this entry reads DRIFTED against upstream main — that is the point of the flag, not a gap. It only speaks up if the entry becomes REDUNDANT (network copy matches vendored) or reads in-sync with upstream (upstream re-added groupPublicView). Re-vendoring or retiring is therefore a MANUAL periodic check, not something the weekly workflow will prompt.
